name: Yuhan
source:
A cheeky and contrarian young man. He lived in the same district as the protagonist when they were younger.

He turns to harsh words to hide his own embarrassment, something he deeply still regrets.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/otomedaoshi/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
